# Readiness Checklist: Adopt LangGraph + Intent Classification (Phase 1b)

**Purpose**: General, broad-coverage requirements-quality pass over `spec.md` — author self-review
before running `/speckit-tasks`. Tests whether the requirements are written completely, clearly, and
consistently; does not test or verify any implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is a maximum bound on the number of labels a single message's classification can carry specified, or left implicitly unbounded? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK002 Are retention/expiration requirements defined for the classification records FR-005 says must be "reviewed afterward," or is retention left unspecified? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Are access-control/authorization expectations for who may review classification records addressed, or explicitly deferred? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK004 Is behavior specified for a patient message that never becomes eligible for classification at all (e.g., rejected by existing message-validation rules before being persisted), as distinct from one whose turn is later superseded? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "match" in SC-003 quantified for multi-label messages — does partial overlap between recorded and expected intents count as a match, or is exact set equality required? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the sample size behind SC-003's "small hand-labeled sample" quantified, or left to interpretation? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the measurement window behind SC-004's "on average" defined (e.g., per session, per day, per N messages), or left unspecified? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Is the model-routing expectation in Assumptions ("a fast, low-cost model, distinct from the model used to generate FAQ answers") captured as a testable functional requirement, or does it remain assumption-only despite reading as a load-bearing constraint? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK009 Can SC-002's "recording mechanism" reliability be objectively measured without a defined sampling or monitoring method, or does the requirement stop short of being independently verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK010 Is SC-004's latency budget specified as a hard ceiling, a statistical average, or both — and is that distinction meaningful for how compliance would actually be assessed? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK011 Are Given/When/Then acceptance scenarios defined for a classification-call failure (FR-007), or does this outcome exist only in Edge Cases, not under any User Story? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-007] — Resolved: added as Acceptance Scenario 4 under User Story 2.
- [ ] CHK012 Are Given/When/Then acceptance scenarios defined for a superseded/cancelled turn's classification outcome (FR-005/FR-006), or does this outcome exist only in Edge Cases? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Is there an acceptance scenario covering the catch-all classification outcome (FR-003) as a normal, successful result, distinct from and not conflated with the failure scenarios? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are determinism/consistency expectations defined for classifying identical or near-identical message content on separate occasions? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Is behavior addressed for a classification result that names zero real intents (neither a defined category nor the catch-all), should that ever occur? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-001]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK016 Are data-handling requirements for classification records complete beyond content minimization (FR-005) — e.g., retention duration, storage-location constraints — or is minimization the only dimension specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK017 Is the dependency on Phase 1a's existing cancel-and-restart mechanism — which FR-006's shared-lifecycle behavior relies on entirely — stated as an explicit dependency, or only inferable from Assumptions' prose? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the assumption that classification is "cost-sensitive" (used to justify bounding context to 5 turns) validated against any stated cost/latency figures, or asserted without a stated basis? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK019 Does "at least FAQ, booking, and escalation" (FR-003) leave the door open to additional categories being added within this phase, or is the taxonomy meant to be closed at exactly four (three plus catch-all) for Phase 1b? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
